scope: Candidate-engine consolidation; preview outputs only. No RV source files were rewritten by this work.
baseline: Frozen user rebuild: 428428 / 695744 eligible displayed words. Concurrent RV edits are recorded separately and were not overwritten.
execution: Sequential four-book batches, -1, all generated files on SSD; peak RSS is per batch, not a measurement of an unbatched all-book run.
limitations: Coverage is not precision. Structural checks cover all mapped passages; only the listed examples and regression fixtures received targeted semantic review. Both valid gains and valid losses exist. Existing links remain anchors, so incremental coverage is not rebuild coverage.
